title: A backend error outside the task body (the deduplication check's read, the STARTED write, the SUCCESS write) acks the task as an internal error: it never runs, or it ran and nothing final is stored
where: the STARTED write path is open celery issue 8588, and open celery PR 11014 addresses it (it waits up to result_backend_store_retry_timeout, 20 s, in the pool process and requeues an acks_late task if STARTED still cannot be stored); the lead's rerun on 9c2f238 with RabbitMQ: about 430 to 460 of 1,500 chains stop in three 2 s Redis kills with task_track_started on, 0 with it off, 0 with result_backend_always_retry. The dedup read path: no upstream thread found (closest celery PR 10960 and 10159); the check has caught only BackendGetMetaError since celery PR 6722 (2021), raised only under result_backend_always_retry; the lead reproduced the STARTED and SUCCESS write paths for celery issue 9835
thread: celery issue 8588 (STARTED write, celery PR 11014); the dedup read path has none yet
observed: 768e476 with kombu 445027e, real prefork workers -c 1 on Redis (broker 6379, backend in its own container on 6391), acks_late, dedup on, visibility_timeout 2 s. Worker A is SIGKILLed 1 s into a 3 s run (injected); the message is restored and worker B takes it. down (the backend container stopped while B takes it, started 8 s later): 2 of 2 runs the task never ran again, the message was acked, the state stayed PENDING; B logged "Exception raised outside body: network:ConnectionError" and "Pool callback raised exception". readonce (the first read in B raises redis ConnectionError, the backend is up): 3 of 3 FAILURE stored, never ran. With result_backend_always_retry: the task ran and ended SUCCESS (downretry 2 of 2, readonceretry 3 of 3). Without dedup the same redelivery simply runs the task. confirm_backend_error_outside_body.py (one acks_late task with task_track_started, a RedisBackend subclass whose STARTED or SUCCESS write raises redis ConnectionError and stays down for the FAILURE write; injected): started 2 of 2 never ran, acked, PENDING; success 2 of 2 ran once, acked, STARTED for ever; with result_backend_always_retry and one failure both ended SUCCESS (2 of 2 each). Every one of the three points acks the message; none leaves it for redelivery.
